manifest.name: canonical-link
manifest.description: One member of a canonical identity cluster, recorded by a human decision. This is a LOGICAL canonical merge - a link, not a deletion: every source record survives untouched, every reference to it keeps resolving, and no field of any other package is rewritten. Physical consolidation is deliberately not part of this milestone.

migrations.name: create_canonical_links
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS canonical_links (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  cluster_key TEXT,
  subject_resource TEXT,
  subject_id TEXT,
  subject_owner TEXT CHECK(subject_owner IN ('host', 'package')),
  subject_owner_package TEXT,
  subject_label TEXT,
  role TEXT CHECK(role IN ('canonical', 'alias')),
  decision_id TEXT,
  reason TEXT,
  decided_by_type TEXT CHECK(decided_by_type IN ('user')),
  decided_by_id TEXT,
  decided_at TEXT,
  status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('active', 'withdrawn')),
  withdrawn_reason TEXT,
  withdrawn_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS canonical_links_cluster_key ON canonical_links(cluster_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS canonical_links_subject_resource ON canonical_links(subject_resource);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS canonical_links_subject_id ON canonical_links(subject_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS canonical_links_role ON canonical_links(role);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS canonical_links_decision_id ON canonical_links(decision_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS canonical_links_status ON canonical_links(status);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_canonical_links
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."canonical_links" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "cluster_key" TEXT,
  "subject_resource" TEXT,
  "subject_id" TEXT,
  "subject_owner" TEXT CHECK("subject_owner" IN ('host', 'package')),
  "subject_owner_package" TEXT,
  "subject_label" TEXT,
  "role" TEXT CHECK("role" IN ('canonical', 'alias')),
  "decision_id" TEXT,
  "reason" TEXT,
  "decided_by_type" TEXT CHECK("decided_by_type" IN ('user')),
  "decided_by_id" TEXT,
  "decided_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "status" TEXT CHECK("status" IN ('active', 'withdrawn')),
  "withdrawn_reason" TEXT,
  "withdrawn_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "canonical_links_cluster_key"
  ON "accordo"."canonical_links"("cluster_key");

CREATE INDEX "canonical_links_subject_resource"
  ON "accordo"."canonical_links"("subject_resource");

CREATE INDEX "canonical_links_subject_id"
  ON "accordo"."canonical_links"("subject_id");

CREATE INDEX "canonical_links_role"
  ON "accordo"."canonical_links"("role");

CREATE INDEX "canonical_links_decision_id"
  ON "accordo"."canonical_links"("decision_id");

CREATE INDEX "canonical_links_status"
  ON "accordo"."canonical_links"("status");
